caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing forward, dressed in a long, light-colored dress with a floral or dot pattern and lace trim at the sleeves, collar, and hem. She wears matching pantaloons visible beneath the dress, which also have lace trim at the bottom. On her head is a bonnet that is yellowish in color with a white ribbon tied under the chin, and she has a shawl or cape draped over her shoulders, also adorned with lace and detailed with a pattern matching the dress. The woman holds a small doll in her left arm, which is also dressed in light clothing. She wears red or dark-colored shoes with visible heels. To the right of the woman, there is a detailed drawing of a bonnet, displayed separately, which is white with intricate patterns and a ribbon. The background is plain, and the composition is centered, with the figure dominating the left portion and the separate headwear on the right. The drawing uses primarily light pastel colors with precise, fine lines for details.
title: Doll
